title: Test the ACP initialize deadline's own timeout branch, and word the expire_initialize fixture as equivalent rather than exact
outcome: The timed branch of wait_for_acp_json_rpc_response (src/acp.rs) has its own deterministic test: a Some(timeout) wait that runs out removes the pending entry and returns the Transport "timed out waiting for" error. The doc of ProductionWorkerTree::expire_initialize and the name of dedicated_rework_acp_initialize_deadline_kills_fake_root no longer claim to apply "exactly" what the deadline does. They drive the untimed recv() Err branch, whose writer cleanup is the same.
acceptance: A test reaches the Some(timeout) expiry branch of wait_for_acp_json_rpc_response and asserts that the pending entry is removed and that the error is a Transport "timed out waiting for" error, with no sleep beyond the bounded wait under test.
The expire_initialize doc and the reproduction test's name or comment describe it as equivalent to the deadline's effect, not as the deadline itself.
TEST_DEDICATED_ACP_INITIALIZE_UNTIMED is consumed even when spawn_acp_runtime returns early, or the fixture clears it after spawn.
The full gate passes on the exact committed tree.

completion.summary: Landed be2ed177735f657128f569191465dadb05fed5e6 on master as a fast-forward from 36a0ca7f, pushed to origin and verified with ls-remote. It adds a deterministic test of the ACP initialize wait's Some(timeout) expiry branch (pending entry removed, Transport "timed out waiting for" error), makes the untimed-initialize test seam consumed before any early return of spawn_acp_runtime (with a refused-spawn test), and rewords the expire_initialize fixture and reproduction test as an equivalent effect rather than the deadline itself. The commit diff equals the gated staged index b09da357; the full gate test-6d4cfb09 is host record fd19c5cb (passed, content-v1:02e4bb79); independent evaluation cc4df9ea passed 4/4.
